projects.title: Kick! - Automation as a Service
projects.description:
Kick! - Automation as a Service is a platform (PaaS) with distributed sites across 8 global sites. Cisco Security The platform allows Cisco Security engineers to easily develop, execute, and orchestrate different types of automation: 1) Deployment (vmware,aws, azure) Automation, 2) Configuration Automation, and 3) Test Automation (including CI/CD)

Various technologies were used for the platform: node.js, AngularJS, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Selenium, Jenkins, Java, Grafana, & Docker
Contributors

projects.title: Behavior Simulation
projects.description: Created native C programs to simulate and statistically analyze behaviors of bean beetles and published papers based on the results.

publications.title: Testing and mapping non-stationarity in animal behavioral processes: A case study on an individual female bean weevil

patents.title: Method and System for Implementing a Mobile Trusted Platform Module
patents.description: A method for implementing a mobile trusted platform module includes establishing a connection with a first remote host device via a remote interface. The method also includes authenticating the connection. The method further includes, upon authenticating the connection, allowing the first remote host device to access a securely stored first application within a mobile trusted platform module.

patents.title: Method and Apparatus for Identity Verification
patents.description: A method for identity verification includes receiving a request for proof of identity from a service provider and receiving biometric information associated with a user of a communication device. The method also includes determining that the received biometric information matches a biometric profile that contains biometric information associated with a registered user of the communication device. The method also includes unlocking a private key associated with the registered user in response to determining that the received biometric information matches a biometric profile and sending a request for a digital certificate that is signed with the private key associated with the registered user. The method further includes receiving the digital certificate that includes a public key associated with the registered user and satisfies the request for proof of identity. The method also includes with forwarding the digital certificate to the service provider.
